latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Editor Generator — fast, AI-powered video editing in the cloud.

- Instantly edit and export 2-minute screen recordings to 1080p MP4 by describing your desired result.
- Simple upload and prompt workflow; no timeline editing or local installs required.
- Handles cut detection, transitions, BGM, text overlays, and more via intent-based prompt routing.
- Automatic backend connection and session management using NEMO_TOKEN or a starter token.
- Supports common video and audio formats; 500MB max file size.
- Provides clear status updates, timeline summaries, and error explanations throughout the process.
